paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Elazar ben Perata.

So he is listed in Yuchasin, but Hyman has not found this name anywhere. Perhaps the intended reference is [Sanhedrin 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.22a.5); Hyman contrasts that listing with a citation in which Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar speaks in the name of Rabbi Eliezer ben Perata.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman attributes the headword to Yuchasin and tentatively points to this passage. Its first two names are connected by a citation formula, which would account for the apparent lineage in the heading.
The linked Sanhedrin has Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar report in the name of Rabbi Eliezer ben Perata, who reports in the name of Rabbi Elazar HaModa’i.
